en: Sepia-toned historic view of a wide market square bordered by multi‑storey townhouses with gabled roofs and a prominent town hall–like building. People in early 20th‑century dress walk across the largely unpaved square, with market stalls and a streetlamp visible. The caption at the top reads "Ostritz i. Sa. — Markt". German text is also visible on a building façade at the right edge.
